==Trivia==
This event is called "REBEL_TRANSPORT" in the datafiles.
* Despite the flavor text, this ship isn't generated any differently than any other Rebel ship.
* The rewards given by this event are identical to those of [[Pirate smuggler ship]].
* If the enemy escapes, the Rebel Fleet pursuit is '''not''' doubled.
